title: Contract 4: server to page
description: Current state and delay stamps, one message per chunk, sent as JSON text on the /control websocket when the chunk's first frame is sent.

stamps.description: Integer ms after heard, for the most recent command. A field appears once it is known; {} before the first command.

t_client.description: Echo of the most recent command's t_client; null if none.

applies_from_chunk.description: First chunk generated with the most recent command's target; null until known.

heard.description: Text of the most recent command; null if none.

keyword.description: Key word to highlight in heard; null if none.

unmatched.description: True when no operation was found for the most recent command.
